movie:104859.overview: A comedy that follows two high school students -- one overachiever struggling to write his valedictorian speech, the other a senior now going on his 15th year of school.
movie:104859.tagline: Snoop Dogg and Wiz Khalifa get their higher education on
movie:104859.title: Mac & Devin Go to High School

trailer.name: Mac and Devin Go to High School (HD) Trailer

movie:10859.overview: Two detectives observe an escaped convict's ex-girlfriend, but complications set in when one of them falls for her.
movie:10859.tagline: It's a tough job but somebody's got to do it!
movie:10859.title: Stakeout

movie:11059.overview: On an island off the coast, a techno rave party attracts a diverse group of college coeds and a Coast Guard officer. Soon, they discover that their X-laced escapades are to be interrupted by zombies and monsters that attack them on the ground, from the air, and in the sea, ruled by an evil entity.
movie:11059.title: House of the Dead

movie:1159559.overview: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target. Determined to protect her family, Sidney must face the horrors of her past to put an end to the bloodshed once and for all.
movie:1159559.title: Scream 7

movie:11859.overview: Max Kirkpatrick is a cop who protects Kate McQuean, a civil law attorney, from a renegade KGB team out to terminate her
movie:11859.tagline: He's a cop on the edge. She's a woman with a dangerous secret. They've been targeted by the Russian mob, and now they're both Fair Game.
movie:11859.title: Fair Game

movie:11959.overview: The eccentric new manager of a UHF television channel tries to save the station from financial ruin with an odd array of programming.
movie:11959.tagline: A lot of TV stations have forgotten what "quality" means, but not Channel 62. They NEVER knew what it meant.
movie:11959.title: UHF

movie:12259.overview: After his family is slain by notorious bandit Gabbar Singh, former Inspector Thakur Baldev Singh enlists low-level outlaws Jai and Veeru to capture Gabbar and seek revenge.
movie:12259.tagline: The greatest cast ever assembled! The greatest story ever told!
movie:12259.title: Sholay

trailer.name: India’s Biggest Blockbuster Is Back in cinemas [ENG SUB]

movie:1245859.overview: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.
movie:1245859.tagline: Polite society has never been so Savage.
movie:1245859.title: Savage House

movie:1285959.overview: Hassan, a Somali-American airport shuttle driver in Minneapolis, is struggling to make ends meet. When Lloyd, a stranded twenty-something at the airport, offers to pay Hassan to take him overland to Chicago, it seems worth the risk. But as the realization grows that his passenger is not what he seems, Hassan finds himself trapped in a terrifying ride that he can’t escape, knowing that saving himself might put countless others in danger.
movie:1285959.tagline: No way out. No way back.
movie:1285959.title: The Passenger

movie:1288059.overview: When a naive young man becomes the sexual muse for a renowned and provocative artist, his dream job quickly turns dangerous as he is drawn into an obsessive world of power, betrayal, and murder.
movie:1288059.title: I Want Your Sex

movie:1291659.overview: In the chaos of post-Soviet Russia, rising KGB officer Vladimir Putin joins forces with master manipulator Vadim Baranov to reshape life behind the Iron Curtain, using violence and deception to change the world forever.
movie:1291659.tagline: Power was the plan. Putin was the consequence.
movie:1291659.title: The Wizard of the Kremlin

movie:13059.overview: A horror film told in three parts, from three perspectives, in which a mysterious transmission that turns people into killers invades every cell phone, radio, and television.
movie:13059.title: The Signal

movie:13159.overview: Rebellious, uncontrollable teenager, Rachel is hauled off by her dysfunctional mother to spend the summer with her estranged grandmother, Georgia. Her journey will lead all three women to revelations of buried family secrets and an understanding that - regardless what happens - the ties that bind can never be broken.
movie:13159.tagline: Mother. Daughter. Grandmother. In this family, attitude doesn't skip a generation.
movie:13159.title: Georgia Rule

movie:1370559.overview: While the Calabrian mafia is spreading its influence in the early 70s, Antonio, son of the high-ranking 'Ndrangheta boss Giacomo Zagari, finds himself killing more and more frequently, ultimately realising that he isn't suited to this extreme lifestyle. While his generation rises up in factories, universities and public squares, Antonio finds the strength to defy his father, rejecting his legacy.
movie:1370559.title: Tired of Killing

movie:1401459.overview: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbet Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbet's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.
movie:1401459.title: Fjord

movie:14859.overview: Natalie is high school royalty, but her queen bee status falls apart when she falls for the new guy at school. Although Keith ignores her at first, they soon become friends -- even though Natalie suspects that Keith has something to hide. As the free-spirited Keith shows Natalie how to embrace what life offers, they grow closer -- until a secret tests the bounds of their relationship
movie:14859.tagline: Love is a force you can't control.
movie:14859.title: Keith

movie:1493859.overview: A group of college students go downstairs to their dorm lobby to get a delivery pizza. There's only one issue: They're insanely high on a homemade drug, turning their simple journey down two sets of stairs into a mind-bendingly transformative quest.
movie:1493859.title: Pizza Movie

movie:152259.overview: The haunted Captain of a Soviet submarine holds the fate of the world in his hands. Forced to leave his family behind, he is charged with leading a covert mission cloaked in mystery.
movie:152259.tagline: You will never see it coming.
movie:152259.title: Phantom

movie:1536559.overview: Tim Kao, the meticulous head chef of a five-star hotel in Taiwan, is set to marry his Hong Kong fiance Daisy Wu. But Tim’s divorced parents refuse to attend the same ceremony, and each insists on hosting their own. To complicate things further, the Feng Shui master chooses the same auspicious date for both events. Tim, Daisy, their wedding planner Regina, and the best man Tsai must orchestrate two weddings simultaneously in the same hotel, without either parent finding out. Surrounded by a strict father, a demanding mother, and a cast of sharp-tongued relatives, Tim must confront the traumas of his upbringing and ask himself: is he truly ready to start a new family of his own?
movie:1536559.title: Double Happiness

movie:15859.overview: A young couple's love is tested when Sun-jin is diagnosed with a rare form of Alzheimer's disease.
movie:15859.tagline: Everything passes away, but I wish I could remember my love forever.
movie:15859.title: A Moment to Remember

movie:1642859.overview: With unprecedented access to the official archives and intimate recollections from the band, both current and past,  Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition invites fans to experience one of the most iconic journeys in music history.  Spanning five decades, this electrifying documentary charts the band’s rise from the pubs of East London to the world’s biggest stadiums. Featuring exclusive interviews with band members and contributors such as Javier Bardem, Lars Ulrich and Chuck D, as well as all-new animated sequences of the band's legendary mascot, Eddie, the film offers a rare and intimate look at Iron Maiden’s uncompromising vision and unwavering connection with their truly global army of fans.
movie:1642859.title: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition

movie:17159.overview: Eddie Murphy delights, shocks and entertains with dead-on celebrity impersonations, observations on '80s love, sex and marriage, a remembrance of Mom's hamburgers and much more.
movie:17159.title: Eddie Murphy Raw

movie:1752159.overview: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.
movie:1752159.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11

movie:1859.overview: A stern Russian woman sent to Paris on official business finds herself attracted to a man who represents everything she is supposed to detest.
movie:1859.title: Ninotchka

cast.c: The Woman Who Rocks the Cradle

movie:3059.overview: The story of a poor young woman, separated by prejudice from her husband and baby, is interwoven with tales of intolerance from throughout history.
movie:3059.title: Intolerance: Love's Struggle Throughout the Ages

movie:30959.overview: Taking its title from an archaic Japanese word meaning "ghost story," this anthology adapts four folk tales. A penniless samurai marries for money with tragic results. A man stranded in a blizzard is saved by Yuki the Snow Maiden, but his rescue comes at a cost. Blind musician Hoichi is forced to perform for an audience of ghosts. An author relates the story of a samurai who sees another warrior's reflection in his teacup.
movie:30959.tagline: In the tradition of "RASHOMON" and "GATE OF HELL."
movie:30959.title: Kwaidan

movie:31359.overview: Eddie, Dov, and Yvan are back, still working in Paris' Sentier textile district, This time they're confronting the high-stakes world of large distribution after striking a deal with Eurodiscount, a European hypermarket chain.
movie:31359.title: Would I Lie to You? 2

movie:438259.overview: Set in a dugout in Aisne in 1918, a group of British officers, led by the mentally disintegrating young officer Stanhope, variously await their fate.
movie:438259.title: Journey's End

movie:459.overview: After a wonderful time in Hungary Sissi falls extremely ill and must retreat to a Mediterranean climate to rest. The young empress’ mother takes her from Austria to recover in Madeira.
movie:459.title: Sissi: The Fateful Years of an Empress

trailer.name: Sissi (1955) | Trailer | Romy Schneider | Karlheinz Böhm | Magda Schneider

movie:460059.overview: Tony, a promising young motorcycle racer, is forced to do perilous drug runs to save the mother of his child from a dangerous mobster.
movie:460059.title: Burn Out

movie:475759.overview: “2048: Nowhere to Run” takes place one year before the events of Blade Runner 2049. The short film focuses on Sapper, a man who is trying to make it through life day-by-day without turning back to his old ways. We’re introduced to both the gentle nature of Sapper and the violence he’s capable of when set off.
movie:475759.title: 2048: Nowhere to Run

trailer.name: Blade Runner 2049 - "2048: Nowhere To Run" Short Film - Starring Dave Bautista

movie:50759.overview: Widower Shuhei Hirayama's caretaker is his 24-year-old daughter, Michiko. Gradually, he comes to realize that Michiko should not be obliged to look after him for the rest of his life, so he arranges a marriage for her.
movie:50759.title: An Autumn Afternoon

movie:537059.overview: The Justice League faces a powerful new threat — the Fatal Five! Superman, Batman and Wonder Woman seek answers as the time-traveling trio of Mano, Persuader and Tharok terrorize Metropolis in search of budding Green Lantern, Jessica Cruz. With her unwilling help, they aim to free remaining Fatal Five members Emerald Empress and Validus to carry out their sinister plan. But the Justice League has also discovered an ally from another time in the peculiar Star Boy — brimming with volatile power, could he be the key to thwarting the Fatal Five? An epic battle against ultimate evil awaits!
movie:537059.tagline: When the future collides with the past, there's no time to waste.
movie:537059.title: Justice League vs. the Fatal Five

movie:585759.overview: Warsaw, Poland, during the Cuban Missile Crisis, 1962. Josh Mansky, a troubled math genius and former US chess champion, is recruited to hold a dangerous public match against the Soviet champion, while playing the deadly game of espionage hidden in the darkest shadows of a hostile territory.
movie:585759.tagline: Times change — The stakes remain the same.
movie:585759.title: The Coldest Game

movie:845659.overview: A female boxing trainer discovers that her champion cage-fighter boyfriend has been cheating on her with her sister and decides to seek revenge by training up his arch-rival to challenge him.
movie:845659.title: Perfect Addiction

movie:9959.overview: A black police detective must solve a strange case of a kidnapped boy and deal with a big racial protest.
movie:9959.tagline: The Truth Is Hiding Where No One Dares To Look.
movie:9959.title: Freedomland

tv:113959.overview: In 1972, the first Black female FBI agent heads to the Southwest and recruits a gutsy getaway driver in a bold effort to take down a growing crime syndicate.
tv:113959.title: Duster

tv:1759.overview: The Cosby Show is an American television situation comedy starring Bill Cosby, which aired for eight seasons on NBC from September 20, 1984 until April 30, 1992. The show focuses on the Huxtable family, an upper middle-class African-American family living in Brooklyn, New York.
tv:1759.title: The Cosby Show

tv:2359.overview: Workaholic Mike Flaherty is the Deputy Mayor of New York City, serving as Mayor Randall Winston's key strategist and much-needed handler. Mike runs the city with the help of his oddball staff: an anxious and insecure press secretary; a sexist, boorish chief of staff; an impeccably groomed gay activist running minority affairs; a sharp and efficient, man-crazy accountant; and an idealistic young speechwriter. Like Mike, they are all professionally capable but personally challenged.
tv:2359.title: Spin City

tv:240459.overview: In a world where he survived the events of Spartacus, Ashur clawed his way to power, owning the same ludus that once owned him. Allying with a fierce gladiatrix, Ashur ignites a new kind of spectacle that offends the elite.
tv:240459.title: Spartacus: House of Ashur

tv:255859.overview: A small-town cop suspects that the local school for troubled teens — and its dangerously charismatic founder — may not be all it seems.
tv:255859.tagline: We think you'll be very happy here.
tv:255859.title: Wayward

tv:272059.overview: In a world full of brilliant heroes, it’s the trust of fans that turns heroes into superheroes. If a hero loses the people’s trust, they lose their special abilities. Trust value is collected, quantified, and used to determine a hero’s ranking, displayed on their wrist. Every two years, the top heroes go to a tournament to fight, determine new trust values, and earn their rankings.
tv:272059.title: TO BE HERO X

tv:288659.overview: When the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Kayo, is abducted, spring itself vanishes—plunging the world into unending winter. Refusing to give up, her devoted guard, Sakura Himedaka, searches for her for years. When Hinagiku suddenly returns, the two set out to restore the lost season, face the past that tore them apart, and reclaim the warmth they refuse to lose again.
tv:288659.title: Agents of the Four Seasons Dance of Spring

tv:312359.overview:
When Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens in search of a worthy rival, Goku and his friends face an epic battle to stop him from destroying Earth.

Remastered and re-edited version of Dragon Ball Super.
tv:312359.title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus

tv:321559.overview: While hiding a kidnapped target, a contract killer’s cover unravels when he falls for the detective hunting the truth.
tv:321559.tagline: A fatal romance blooming amid heart-stopping tension
tv:321559.title: The Lie We Lived In

tv:60059.overview: Six years before Saul Goodman meets Walter White. We meet him when the man who will become Saul Goodman is known as Jimmy McGill, a small-time lawyer searching for his destiny, and, more immediately, hustling to make ends meet. Working alongside, and, often, against Jimmy, is “fixer” Mike Ehrmantraut. The series tracks Jimmy’s transformation into Saul Goodman, the man who puts “criminal” in “criminal lawyer".
tv:60059.title: Better Call Saul
